```artifact
Feature: U27_misc

  Scenario: Speciality does not exist with Speciality Id
    Given the Speciality with Id "123" does not exist
    When the system attempts to retrieve the Speciality
    Then an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors
    Given the user is logged in as an Administrator
    When the user navigates to the Administrators Menu Screen
    Then the screen should display options to Maintain Doctors

  Scenario: Add Doctor Screen
    Given the user is on the Add Doctor Screen
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | 1         | John Doe    | 30  | M   | MBBS          | 5          |
    And the user submits the form
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully

  Scenario: Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    Given the user is on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Experience | Qualification |
      | 1         | John Doe    | 31  | M   | 6          | MD            |
    And the user submits the form
    Then the Doctor details should be updated successfully

  Scenario: Doctor does not exist with Doctor Id
    Given the Doctor with Id "456" does not exist
    When the system attempts to retrieve the Doctor
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Deleting Doctor Details with open Consultation Requests
    Given the Doctor with Id "789" has open Consultation Requests
    When the user attempts to delete the Doctor
    Then an exception error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" should be displayed

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given the user is logged in as an Administrator
    When the user navigates to the Administrators Menu Screen
    Then the screen should display options to Maintain Chemist & Labs

  Scenario: Add Chemist/ Lab Screen
    Given the user is on the Add Chemist/ Lab Screen
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | 1              | C                | ChemLab Inc.     | 123 Main St         | contact@chemlab.com         |
    And the user submits the form
    Then the Chemist/ Lab should be added successfully
```
